fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek reported Q3 revenue of NT$168.06 billion (up 18.3% YoY, up 10.4% QoQ), net income of NT$28.2 billion (up 10.8% YoY), operating margin of 16.1%, and EPS of NT$17.5.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q4 revenue is expected to be NT$210.1–221.8 billion (up 25–32% QoQ), with guidance for gross margin of 45% ±1.5pp and operating expense ratio of 26% ±2pp.
fields.summary_ko.2: The first-generation AI accelerator will contribute $2.5 billion in Q4, with a target of approximately $16 billion at the upper end in 2027 (approximately 20% of the AI accelerator ASIC market), while the second generation is advancing toward mass production in Q1 2028.
